_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::tsi#8. Upstream tsi_lincompression_monolithic run twice, differing only in SOLVER 2 (the block TSI DYNAMIC/MONOLITHIC points LINEAR_SOLVER at). Belos + Teko runs to 'processor 0 finished normally' with all 8 result tests CORRECT; swapping it for UMFPACK aborts inside TSI::Monolithic::create_linear_solver, exit 1, before any time step (UMFPACK_REACHED_FIRST_TIME_STEP=0). So the rule holds. The Signal does not: 'monolithic TSI requires Belos' does not occur (CLAIMED_REQUIRES_BELOS_TEXT=0). The real message is the two-word 'Iterative solver expected' from src/tsi/4C_tsi_monolithic.cpp, which names neither Belos nor the solver you wrote (DIAGNOSTIC_NAMES_BELOS=0, DIAGNOSTIC_NAMES_UMFPACK=0) — grepping the error for either finds nothing. Both arms run with cwd on a scratch dir carrying a symlink to the upstream xml/ tree because the deck's SOLVER_XML_FILE paths are relative. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C 2026.2.0-dev (git 89519cf) at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C.
